newsitem.title: CROATIA: Karlovacka brewery froths in firmer Croatian market.
newsitem.headline: Karlovacka brewery froths in firmer Croatian market.

text.p: Shares in Karlovacka Pivovara brewery frothed up to a record 590 kuna in a firmer Croatian market on Wednesday, traders said.
"Karlovacka has gone crazy, talk about the hot stock. Now that it has been discovered, there are a lot of buy orders," said Josko Milisa of I.C.F. consultancy and brokerage.
He said it drove the share price of the brewery, a subsidiary of Chile's Compania Cervecerias Unidas, up from its 570 kuna close on Tuesday.
But no more than 300 shares were sold up to 1100 GMT, an hour before the market's close, compared to 2,120 on Tuesday.
Zagrebacka Banka ordinaries firmed 10 kuna to 1,930 on volume of 1,150 units.
Its preferred E-series stock also rose 25 kuna to 1,450 and 100 shares out of a 660 total fetched a higher 1,460 kuna.

Milisa also noted stronger investor interest in three industrial stocks -- Zagreb's tobacco factory TDZ, Nasicecement and coffee and cocktail snacks producer Franck -- for which there were no sell orders. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
